fields.Name: T248 - Active Tasks Dropdown In Nav
fields.Description: Exercises the TasksDropdownComponent embedded in the nav bar — a quick-access surface distinct from the full Tasks tab view.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Chat application and wait for the workspace. In the top navigation bar (right side, left of the search icon) there is a tasks dropdown control. Click it and confirm a dropdown/popover opens listing active or recent tasks (or a clear empty state when there are none). Seeing the tasks dropdown open with its content or empty state is success — you do NOT need to act on any task. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A tasks dropdown control is present in the top navigation and opens when clicked
The dropdown shows active/recent tasks or a valid empty state
The dropdown closes cleanly when dismissed
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
